name: Websites4Christians
shortDescription: A Scottish website provider for churches and Christian organisations. It offers tailored builds, managed hosting, email, backups, security updates and telephone support.
company: Project Huddle Ltd (trading as Websites4Christians), company number SC346323
suitableContexts: UK churches seeking a bespoke managed website rather than a fixed template
Churches wanting supplier-managed hosting, backups and software updates
Churches publishing events, news, member-only content or paid-event workflows

pricing.summary: Published FAQs state a typical bespoke design fee of £500–£800, monthly hosting, security, backup, software upgrades and day-to-day management at £7.99, and optional consultancy at £30/hour. The supplier says it sometimes provides sites or hosting free of charge. Confirm the scope, VAT, support level, payment method and full written quote before ordering.

tiers.label: Managed hosting and maintenance
tiers.detail: Supplier includes hosting, security, backup, software upgrades and day-to-day site management in its published FAQ.

tiers.label: Bespoke design
tiers.detail: Supplier says the range depends on requirements and pages designed.

tiers.label: Consultancy
tiers.detail: Supplier lists this as a possible additional cost.

gdprInformation: The reviewed hosting agreement establishes a contractual hosting service, but this research does not establish a current DPA, data-hosting location, sub-processor list, breach process, retention schedule or controller/processor allocation for each church. Obtain those details and determine what personal data should be held in any member area, contact form or event workflow before use.

Supplier describes PayPal or another merchant system for event ticketing and payment workflows
importExport: Supplier says a church owns its domain and it will help transfer that domain if the service is cancelled
Confirm administrator access, website files, media, database and form-data export arrangements in the current agreement
support: Supplier advertises telephone, email and remote-login technical support
Supplier describes help with content updates and website transfer

operator.value: The supplier’s published hosting agreement identifies Websites4Christians as a trading name of Project Huddle Ltd, registered in Scotland under company number SC346323.

uk-location.value: The supplier publishes an office address at Spiersbridge Business Park in Thornliebank, Glasgow, with a UK telephone number.

pricing-and-exit.value: Published FAQs give the monthly hosting fee, typical design range, consultancy price and domain-transfer assistance on cancellation.

product-scope.value: Supplier describes bespoke church websites with hosting, email, backup, security updates, site management and technical support.

editorial.assessment: Websites4Christians is a bespoke, supplier-supported website service rather than an off-the-shelf church-management suite. It is particularly relevant when a church values a tailored design and ongoing technical help, and its published trading-company identity and domain-transfer statement improve procurement clarity. Because it may host contact, member and event data, a church should still obtain current data-processing and technical arrangements rather than relying on broad security claims.
bestFor: Churches seeking a bespoke public website with ongoing UK supplier support
Teams that need help with hosting, backups, updates and technical troubleshooting
Churches wanting a website with optional member, event or ticketing functions
strengths: Published Scottish trading-company identity and office location
Published entry pricing and typical design range
Bespoke design rather than fixed templates
Hosting, backup, security-update and support scope is described
limitations: Not a church database, safeguarding casework product, Gift Aid processor or accounting system
Price is partly quote-based because design requirements vary
Current DPA, data location, sub-processors, retention, service levels and full content-export terms are not established by the reviewed material
Confirm rights to design assets, source files, administrator access and bespoke development before commissioning work

procurementVerdict.problem: Obtaining a tailored, supported church website without running technical hosting and maintenance internally
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A Scottish Christian web provider combining bespoke builds with a low published ongoing management fee
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request a written scope, accessibility approach, current hosting and DPA information, backup/restore and incident process, source/admin ownership terms and a live example of content, event and member-area administration
